settings.heading: Empowering 5000+ Farmers, Cultivating 9800 Acres of Fertile Land & Delivering Worldwide
settings.text: We proudly support over 5000 farmers, nurturing 9800 acres of organic farmland under NPOP (National Programme for Organic Production) and NOP(National Organic Program) standards and producing 26,300+ MTPA of premium milk.  With a commitment to sustainable farming and fair incomes, we bring farm-fresh goodness to homes across India and 36 countries worldwide. Together, we’re building a healthier, greener future for the upcoming generations.

settings.heading: Celebrating Hard Work and Achievements
settings.text: The annual meet is held every year to recognize the amazing work of our farmers. The best farmers are awarded trophies in this ceremony, and inspiring speeches bring everyone together. Families enjoy meals and celebrate achievements in a warm and joyful atmosphere. This event is our way of saying thank you to the farmers for their hard work and dedication.

settings.caption: Our Farmers - A Success Story
settings.heading: Meet Gurbax Singh (a farmer from Udham Singh Nagar, Uttarakhand)
settings.text: He partnered with us in 2016 and transformed his conventional farm into an organic one. Gurbax Singh was able to increase his crop yields and revenue significantly while reducing his environmental impact.Today, he is recognized as a pioneer in organic farming and serves as an inspiration to many other farmers in his district looking to make the switch.

settings.heading: Veterinary Check up
settings.text: Regular veterinary checkups and the on-call expert doctors offer farmers reliable treatment and assistance with their cows. We prioritize livestock health through proper management and accessible medicine facilities free of cost.Milk from cows kept on antibiotics because of some illness is collected separately in red cans. These practices reflect commitment to obtain the purest form of milk using machines(completely untouched by hands).

settings.heading: Farmer Rewards: Global Insights
settings.text: Each year, two top-performing farmers are selected for an international trip as a token of appreciation. In 2019, our farmers traveled to Singapore to attend an organic farming techniques conference, gaining global insights and experiences. It’s our way of saying thank you!

settings.heading: Farmers' Cricket Tournament
settings.text: Every December, 3,000+ farmers join us for a fun-filled cricket tournament across our villages. The 2-3 day event features exciting matches, with the winning team awarded a trophy by our Directors. Even the management plays,  creating a sense of togetherness and making everyone feel like part of one big family.

settings.heading: Expert Field Officers
settings.text: Our expert field officers with a degree in Agriculture and at least over three years of experience in organic farming and provide 360-degree training tot he farmers with crops and farming needs. Our grower group office connects farmers directly for help and provides quality seeds and seed distribution facilities, giving and helping farmers and their families adopt organic practices with ease and confidence.

settings.heading: Growing Together
settings.text: We believe in the power of working together. Our farmers and team members share ideas, support each other, and find better ways to grow and deliver high-quality organic products.Our team lives in villages as a family and  ensures the leading innovative solutions and strategies to cultivate the best for our customers. Together, we make a difference.We ensure farmers receive the best care and support for their hard work. We offer guidance on creating organic inputs and provide one-on-one training at their doorstep. To value their efforts, we purchase organic inputs from farmers at premium rates, ensuring fair rewards for their dedication. Our certification team stays in villages, helping farmers and their families while ensuring livestock and crop health. Together, we build a sustainable future for organic farming.

settings.heading: Community Care
settings.text:
We believe in giving back to the communities that sustain us. Our efforts focus on improving sanitation, supporting girl child education, and providing medical welfare in villages.

By addressing these essential needs, we aim to uplift lives, create opportunities, and fulfill our social and ethical responsibilities with compassion and care.
